stem: A crop repeatedly reaches severe wilt before each irrigation and then recovers after watering. Which strategy is strongest?
choices: Use visible wilt as the permanent irrigation trigger
Increase EC so plants retain more water
Extend the dryback further to strengthen roots
Set irrigation decisions from measured depletion and crop response so the root zone dries appropriately without repeatedly reaching severe stress
rationale: Repeated severe wilt indicates the dryback target is too aggressive. Irrigation should use measured root-zone depletion and crop response to balance aeration with avoidance of excessive water stress.
